name: agent-resume
description: agent-resume's SessionStart and SessionEnd hooks for Codex: resume warnings, re-index and push of the ended session.

interface.shortDescription: Resume warnings and index refresh for ares
interface.longDescription: SessionStart: warns when the session is already running in another process, was last run on another machine, or in another folder (read from agent-tracker's lifecycle). SessionEnd: re-indexes the ended session for `ares resume` and pushes its index entry to the hub.
